notes.title: Demo: The Toilet Patch
notes.notes:
Hello horror lovers and sad workers!

We’ve recently released a new version of the demo containing a few additions in [b]Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream!
[/b]
[h2]Toilets[/h2]
Players can now interact with the toilet in the game and enjoy a REAL toilet flushing sound effect.

[h2]Loading screen[/h2]
As a big change, there are now a loading screen and a short splash screen before the game startup. This should result in fewer (we expect none) drops in framerate when loading levels. A small loading indicator also pops up at the bottom of the screen making it clearer.

[h2]Near future[/h2]
We’ll participate in the June Steam Next Fest and we’re preparing A LOT of surprises for the demo. If you’ve already played through it, you might wanna give it another go and explore around: you may uncover new things ;)

[h2]Discord[/h2]
You can still join our discord here: https://discord.gg/csd9eRaKQU
Please come by to chat with us!

[h2]Toilets[/h2]
Did we mention you can now flush the toilets?

notes.title: New release date, Localization and Discord
notes.notes:
Hello horror lovers and sad workers!

We're working hard to bring you the most nightmarish experience.
Here are a few news regarding Workaholic Simulator: Leaving the Dream:

[h1]New release date[/h1]
We had some new ideas for extra content, so we've decided to push the release date to the 3rd quarter of 2025 in order to give you the best experience possible.

[h1]Localization[/h1]
With the demo coming (very) soon, we took the decision to localize the game in different languages. We now have: English, French, Russian, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese and Korean. Our game has almost no text, almost all of our story is told with the environment and the mechanics are designed to be learnt empirically 

[h1]Discord[/h1]
Finally, we set up a Discord server, so you can talk with each other, speculate on what the game will be, make theories together, talk with us or just make new friends who likes horror! (or hate their job)
You can join here: https://discord.gg/csd9eRaKQU


We can't wait to see you get your hands on the game! The demo is coming in a few days and we poured our hearts in it!
